limitations: Genotype contradiction retained in canonical audit; frozen source packet not changed.
Negative phenotype omissions are not promoted to measured absence.

patient_identity.statement: QT587 is a female examined at 17 months (P1Y5M), with first symptoms in the first few months after birth.

genotype.statement: Packet homozygosity conflicts with both Table S2 row36 and Table S3 row41: QT587 has heterozygous c.358C>T / Q120X, classified in group B (only one heterozygous mutation). Table S6 row28 leaves allele2 blank.

segregation.statement: The case is labelled isolated; no QT587 parental genotypes, de novo demonstration or cosegregation data are supplied.

evidence.locator: Sheet1 I28; Table S3 group B row41

limitations: Case-specific absence/segregation cannot be inferred from omission.

phase.statement: Only one heterozygous allele is reported, so the packet cannot be treated as a proven biallelic homozygous genotype. A missing second allele is not evidence of homozygosity.

causal_confidence.statement: The nonsense variant is a plausible RPGRIP1 candidate, but the authors explicitly discuss unresolved second variants in single-heterozygote recessive cases. A solved biallelic molecular diagnosis for QT587 is not established.

evidence.locator: Discussion, paragraph beginning Another important point

limitations: No functional study or QT587 segregation is presented; this audits source correspondence, not modern clinical classification.

phenotype_completeness.statement: All five positive packet eye findings correspond to Table S6. First-months onset and extinguished rod/cone responses provide extra detail. The three excluded features are absent from a positive-findings list, not explicitly tested negative.
limitations: Case-specific absence/segregation cannot be inferred from omission.

assessment.statement: c.358C>T / p.Q120X matches the variant text, but the source says heterozygous while the packet says homozygous. Packet NM_020366.4/NP_065099.3/GRCh38 coordinate are not independently normalized by this source review.
limitations: Versioned transcript and genomic coordinate not supplied in these patient tables.

All main text, two main tables and all six supplementary workbooks inspected. Original XLS cells remain authoritative where PDF pagination splits headings. No new statistical testing.

Source-internal apparent gene-label errors: S6 C21 says SPATA7 for LH17, whereas S2/S3 and main assign the two variants to CEP290; S6 C55 says CRB1 for RP208 c.1312C>T while S2/S3/main say GUCY2D. These do not change QT587 correspondence.

Detection yield includes predicted/uncertain and monoallelic findings; the article adjusts 78 variant alleles to72 after removing six possible modifier/benign alleles, not a confirmed diagnostic yield.
S1 rows323–324 both label MERTK-E11F; reproduced rather than silently corrected.
